name: Cantaloupe

schedule.notes: Peat pots only — melons hate root disturbance.
Wait for soil 70+ F. Use black plastic mulch in short-season climates.

harvest.cues: Stem slips off the fruit with light pressure ('full slip'). Strong cantaloupe perfume at the blossom end.
harvest.storageNotes: Counter to finish ripening; fridge 5 to 7 days cut or whole-ripe.

varieties.name: Minnesota Midget
varieties.notes: Bred for short summers, small 4 to 6 in fruit. Good for cool climates.

notes: Heat is everything — even one cool week stalls them. Mulch with black plastic in zones 5 and colder; cover with row cloth at transplant. Reduce water once fruit starts to net.
